intent: A slide-over shopping bag with drawn thumbnails, steppers, inline undo, an animated free-shipping bar and an upsell, becoming a full-height bottom sheet on phones.

layout.desktop: 440px right panel, full height, scrim black/60 with 2px blur
layout.mobile: bottom sheet from top 12px, 22px top radius, 40x4 drag handle
sections: free-shipping card with track, fill and riding truck disc
footer: subtotal/shipping dl + 56px checkout pill with total capsule + reassurance line
layout.item: 72x84 thumbnail, name/variant left, line price right, stepper + Remove along the bottom

color.accent: #d7e3a4 lime (count chip, success, total capsule, undo pill)

motion.panel: spring stiffness 340 damping 36; x 100% -> 0 desktop, y 100% -> 0 mobile
motion.shipping: fill width + truck left on spring stiffness 120 damping 20; truck rotates [0,-8,0] on unlock
motion.undo: 2px line drains over 5s (CSS keyframes tm-cart-drawer-undo), pauses on hover/focus

responsive.mobile: bottom sheet, 44px touch targets, safe-area bottom padding
responsive.store: demo store grid 2 cols -> 4 cols at md

accessibility: role=dialog, aria-modal, labelled by the title and described by the shipping status
focus moves to the dialog, Tab is trapped, Esc and scrim close, focus returns to the trigger
steppers are labelled groups; the minus at qty 1 reads 'Remove …'
polite live region for quantity, remove and restore
shipping bar is a progressbar with values

items: Waxed field notebook — A5 · Olive · Dot grid — £18 × 2
Merino trail socks — Rust · Size M — £14
content.upsell: Brass bullet pencil — Lives in the notebook’s spine. — £12

avoid: undo hidden in a distant toast
